regional_summary_6h.headline: Georgia political pressure dominates; Armenia pivots on Russia base and US TRIPP outreach
bullets: Georgian authorities are questioning politicians over ex-PM claims on Lazare Jorbenadze's death while detaining animal-rights defender Tamaz Elizbarashvili on 'making threats' charges, signaling a widening domestic pressure campaign.
Armenian PM Pashinyan publicly stated Yerevan would not object to a Russian military-base withdrawal, while Armenian and US officials were in Syunik the same day meeting local communities on TRIPP.
US pressure on Iran via sanctions and blockade is registering impact, as Washington separately hails Syrian chemical-materials destruction progress.
